capabilities: generate index files for folders and subfolders
rename index files when folders are renamed
link and alphabetically sort files and headings in the index
embed folder index content via a folder-index-content block
show folders as nodes in the Graph View linking their contents
extras: README includes manual ZIP installation steps and recommends the File Tree Alternative plugin; frontmatter 'title' key can override the filename shown in the index.
problem: Obsidian folders are not notes, so there is no built-in way to open a folder as a note or see an index of its contents.

relations.evidence: Support for File Tree Alternative Plugin (I highly recommend this plugin)

summary: Folder index generator that creates and maintains a Map of Content note for each folder, linking all contained files.
